2610.11299.title: DuplexAgent-RSI: Recursive Harness Improvement for Full-Duplex Voice Agent Collaboration
2610.11299.paper_summary: Voice agents are converging on a collaboration pattern: a full-duplex interaction model stays on the live channel as the entry to the conversation, while search, reasoning, and coding are handled through asynchronous delegation. A duplex model supports continuous listening and speaking, but complex reasoning and tool use may exceed its capabilities. A coding agent can plan and execute extended tasks, but its sequential interface is a poor fit for live conversation. Combining them requires a harness that coordinates task acceptance, progress, cancellation, replacement, and result delivery while keeping the conversation responsive. Existing harnesses often rely on coupled heuristics, making them difficult to improve systematically from evidence. We present DuplexAgent, a full-duplex collaboration system whose harness expresses this workflow as six editable modules, and Duplex-Harness-RSI, a closed loop that revises them from interaction traces. A simulator automatically generates timed test conversations, runs the system, and produces failure traces that identify the collaboration modules requiring repair. Reasoning LLMs and coding agents in the delegation pool also serve the improvement loop: the Exam Planner selects the next tests from observed weaknesses and the repair archive, and the Harness Editor proposes targeted module changes. The capabilities that serve the user thus also improve the system's coordination. Experiments on intelligence, agentic, and duplex benchmarks show that DuplexAgent combines continuous interaction with difficult reasoning and complex task execution, achieving stronger spoken-knowledge and executable-tool scores than the compared delegated systems while maintaining strong interruption response. A harness ablation further shows that this modular, verifiable loop outperforms the initial harness and repeated editing that lacks its diagnosis and repair archive.
2610.11299.paper_summary_zh: 語音代理正在趨向一種協作模式：全雙工互動模型作為進入對話的渠道，保持在實時通道上，而搜索、推理和編碼則通過異步委派來處理。雙工模型支持持續的聆聽和說話，但複雜的推理和工具使用可能超出其能力範圍。一個編碼代理可以計劃和執行擴展任務，但其順序接口不適合實時對話。將它們結合需要一個協調任務接受、進展、取消、替換和結果交付的裝置，同時保持對話的響應性。現有的裝置通常依賴於耦合啟發式，這使得它們難以從證據中系統性地改進。我們提出了DuplexAgent，一個全雙工協作系統，其裝置將這一工作流程表達為六個可編輯模塊，還有Duplex-Harness-RSI，一個從互動痕跡中修訂它們的閉環。模擬器自動生成定時測試對話，運行系統，並產生識別需要修復的協作模塊的失敗痕跡。委派池中的推理LLM和編碼代理也服務於改進循環：考試計劃者從觀察到的弱點和修復檔案中選擇下一個測試，而裝置編輯器則提出針對性的模塊變更。服務於用戶的能力因此也改善了系統的協調。在智力、代理性和雙工基準上的實驗顯示，DuplexAgent將持續互動與困難的推理和複雜的任務執行相結合，實現了比比較的委派系統更強的口語知識和可執行工具分數，同時保持強大的中斷響應。裝置消融進一步顯示，這種模塊化、可驗證的循環優於初始裝置和缺乏其診斷和修復檔案的重複編輯。
